name: Children's Discovery Museum Summer Camps
operator_name: Children's Discovery Museum of Central Maine
description_short: Week long camps from the children's museum in Waterville: Camp Lab Coat, a science camp for ages 7 to 10; Kids at the Museum, a half day camp of art, science and play for ages 3 to 5; and Kids in the Woods, an outdoor camp for ages 6 to 9 at Quarry Road Trails with hiking and mountain biking.
notes: Camp Lab Coat and Kids in the Woods run Monday to Thursday 9 to 3 and Friday 9 to 12; Kids at the Museum runs 9 to 12 daily. Kids in the Woods includes an optional free lunch and morning snack.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. The page shows dates as 6/22 and so on with no year; the museum's own registration forms linked from it are titled 'Kids at the Museum 2026 Summer Program' and 'Kids in the Woods 2026 Summer Program', and the weekdays match 2026. Camp Lab Coat and the first Kids at the Museum week are marked full on the page.

warnings: The form for Kids at the Museum also states the 2026 sessions: August 3 to 7 (full) and August 10 to 14.
